It is located in [[Suruga Province]].

== Overview ==
[[File:Nahe-jinja-torii.jpg|thumb|<center>Torii of Nahe Shrine</center>]]
Because it stands at the foot of Tōme-yama ({{ill|Mount Kokuzo|Q64712681|qid=Q64712681|lt=Kokūzō-yama}}), a {{ill|Sacred mountains|Q1595289|qid=Q1595289|lt=kannabi mountain}}, it is also called "Kokūzō-san."

Shrine tradition says it was founded in Year 3 of {{ill|Emperor Keitai|Q349277|qid=Q349277}} ({{ill|509|Q30977|qid=Q30977}}) through a solicitation by the {{ill|Mononobe clan|Q1755836|qid=Q1755836}}.

It is also said that it was first worshiped at a sacred rock in the sea off Nabesaki, and later moved to Tōme-yama (Kokūzō-yama).

It is a {{ill|Shikinaisha|fr|Shikinaisha|zh|式內社|qid=Q134917286|lt=Shikinaisha}} listed in the '{{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|Q11064932|qid=Q11064932}}'. In the '{{ill|UNKNOWN|lt=Suruga no Kuni Jinmyōchō}}', it appears as "Nahe Tenjin" with Junior Fifth Rank, Lower Grade.

In the {{ill|Edo|Q215646|qid=Q215646}}, it was also called Nabeshima Daimyōjin, Nabe Shrine, and Nabesaki Daimyōjin.

During the {{ill|Meiji era|ar|فترة مييجي|ast|Dómina Meiji|az|Meydzi dövrü|azb|مئی‌جی دؤورو|be|Перыяд Мэйдзі|bn|মেইজি যুগ|bo|མེའི་ཇིའི་དུས་དུས་མཚམས།|ca|Era Meiji|cs|Období Meidži|da|Meiji-perioden|de|Meiji-Zeit|el|Μεϊτζί (περίοδος)|es|Era Meiji|et|Meiji periood|eu|Meiji Aroa|fa|دوره میجی|fi|Meiji-kausi|fr|Ère Meiji|gl|Período Meiji|he|תקופת מייג'י|hr|Meiji (razdoblje)|ht|Epòk Meiji|hu|Meidzsi-kor|id|Zaman Meiji|io|Ero Meiji|is|Meiji-tímabilið|it|Periodo Meiji|ja|明治|ka|მეიძის ეპოქა|kbp|Mejii wɛɛ yaa alɩwaatʊ|kk|Мэйдзи дәуірі|ko|메이지 시대|la|Aetas Meiji|lt|Meidži laikotarpis|lv|Meidzi periods|mk|Меиџи (период)|mn|Мэйжийн эрин|ms|Zaman Meiji|nl|Meijiperiode|nn|Meiji|no|Meiji-perioden|pl|Meiji (okres)|pt|Era Meiji|ro|Perioada Meiji|ru|Мэйдзи|simple|Meiji period|sk|Obdobie Meidži|sq|Periudha Meixhi|sr|Меиџи период|sv|Meijiperioden|ta|மெய்சி காலம்|th|ยุคเมจิ|tl|Panahong Meiji|tr|Meiji Dönemi|uk|Період Мейдзі|ur|میجی دور|vi|Thời kỳ Minh Trị|war|Panahon Meiji|wuu|明治|zh|明治|zh_classical|明治|zh_min_nan|Bêng-tī|zh_yue|明治|qid=Q3125096}} period's {{ill|Shinbutsu bunri|Q1970535|qid=Q1970535}}, it was separated from Ganjō-ji.
